mathematics.assertion_tested: At the six listed benchmark radii the continuous uniform-disk boundary superposition for Sigma=exp(-R/Rd), Rd=1 kpc, agrees with the published Freeman I0K0-I1K1 formula to relative tolerance 1e-7; the calculation separates continuous-kernel accuracy from a sharp annular step-function approximation.
